generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The test covers both threshold types (count and size), verifies that only the relevant request headers appear in the log message, confirms that unrelated headers are filtered out, and asserts that only the first warning survives in the response. The test is well-structured and the expectations align with the implementation. No issues.
The three call-site refactors are straightforward and correct. The old string-concatenation warnings are replaced with the shared helper, eliminating duplication. No issues.

review_comment: TBD: From a user's perspective it would be convenient to also include `User-Agent` in here. Though, currently, that isn't part of the headers that are copied over. I'm on the fence if to add it or not.
I'd be inclined not to. We don't use this to identify requests elsewhere.
